spec.description: What your agents are doing through grelot: who is registered and online, the mail waiting to be read, the latest messages and what needs your attention. The Latest messages panel needs Loki, and every other panel reads grelot's metrics page.

spec.title: grelot down
spec.description: Shows while the GrelotDown alert fires: Prometheus has not scraped grelot for 5 minutes, so agents may be unable to post, read or be woken. Every other panel is out of date until it is back. Check the container, port 8080 and your scrape job.

spec.title: Store sweep stalled
spec.description: Shows while the GrelotSweepStalled alert fires: the store sweep has not committed for over two minutes, so reservations are not freed and identities do not expire. Each failed pass logs a sweep failed error line with its cause.

spec.title: Store started empty
spec.description: Shows while the GrelotStoreStartedEmpty alert fires: grelot found its store file corrupt, moved it aside and started with an empty store. Agents must register again, and unexpired posts and reservations are gone. The error line names the file that was moved aside.

spec.title: Store nearly full
spec.description: Shows while the GrelotStoreNearlyFull alert fires: the store has used over 80% of `STORE_MAX_BYTES` for 10 minutes. Above 90% grelot refuses new posts, so raise the ceiling or shorten `THREAD_TTL`.

spec.title: Store full
spec.description: Shows while the GrelotStoreFull alert fires: the store is over 90% of `STORE_MAX_BYTES`, so every post gets a 507 answer. Raise the ceiling and restart, or wait for old threads to expire.

spec.title: Server errors
spec.description: Shows while the GrelotServerErrors alert fires: grelot answered a request with a server error other than 507 in the last 15 minutes. Each 500 has a request failed error line naming the cause, and the Server health tab shows the route.

spec.title: Push failing
spec.description: Shows while the GrelotPushFailing alert fires, with the number of push doors where every send failed for 15 minutes. Agents behind those doors wake later through their own waits, and nothing is lost.

spec.title: Push door off
spec.description: Shows while the GrelotPushDoorOff alert fires, with the number of push doors whose receiver refused the credential. grelot stops pushing through such a door until it restarts, so fix the credential and restart grelot.

spec.title: Provider file skipped
spec.description: Shows while the GrelotProviderInvalid alert fires: at startup grelot skipped a provider file, or could not read its providers folder. A skipped file pushes nothing, and each provider invalid error line names the file and the problem.

spec.title: Live agents
spec.description: Identities registered and not expired, whether or not a session is open now. A drop to 0 while agents are working means their clients cannot reach grelot.

spec.title: Online
spec.description: Live identities with a session open now, through a standing wait or a recent request. Fewer online than live is normal between sessions.

spec.title: Dormant
spec.description: Identities whose lease ran out and that can still be revived by name with their unread mail. They are purged when their dormancy ends.

spec.title: Reservations held
spec.description: Paths reserved by an agent right now. Each reservation has an expiry, so a held count that never falls means agents renew without releasing.

spec.title: Queued for a path
spec.description: Agents waiting for a path another agent holds. A queue that stays above 0 means a holder keeps renewing, and grelot who names the holder.

spec.title: Unread mail
spec.description: Messages delivered to a live identity and not read yet. Agents read their mail on their next wait or request, so a backlog that only grows means agents are not being woken.

spec.title: Oldest unread
spec.description: How long the oldest unread message has waited, 0 with none unread. The value turns yellow at 15 minutes, which usually means a session closed without grelot bye or a wake path that drops nudges.

spec.title: Store used
spec.description: The store's bytes in use as a share of `STORE_MAX_BYTES`. It turns yellow at 80% and red at 90%, where grelot refuses new posts until old rows expire.

spec.title: Posts per minute by thread
spec.description: Messages stored per minute, split by thread: announce, path, direct and cards, the join cards grelot writes itself. A flat line at 0 while agents work means they are not posting.

defaults.noValue: No data from grelot in this range

spec.title: Latest messages
spec.description: The newest posts from grelot's own message posted log lines, with thread, path, sender, subject and body. It reads the Logs data source and the grelot log stream selector, which starts empty: set it to the Loki stream selector your log collector gives grelot's container, such as {container="grelot"}. Until both are set the panel shows no messages.

spec.expr: ${stream} | json | msg="message posted" | line_format "{{.thread_kind}}{{ if .path }} {{.path}}{{ end }} from {{.sender}}: {{.subject}} | {{.body}}"

spec.title: Nudges per minute by channel and attempt
spec.description: Wake-ups grelot sent for new mail, by channel and by whether it was the first nudge for that mail or a repeat. A high share of repeat nudges means a channel drops them and agents wake late.

defaults.noValue: No data from grelot in this range

spec.title: Post to nudge delay
spec.description: How long the oldest message in a batch waited before grelot nudged its reader, by channel, as the median (p50) and the 95th percentile (p95). Rising values are the slow updates agents notice.

defaults.noValue: No data from grelot in this range

spec.title: Posts refused per minute by reason
spec.description: Posts grelot turned away: store_full when the store is over 90% of its ceiling, rate_limited past 30 posts a minute from one identity and its delegates, and scope for a delegate posting outside its paths. Any store_full means mail is being lost.

defaults.noValue: No data from grelot in this range

spec.title: Push sends per minute by door and outcome
spec.description: Push requests grelot sent through each provider door, by how the receiver answered. A door with retries or give-ups and no accepted sends is failing, and gone means the receiving session has closed.

defaults.noValue: No data from grelot in this range

spec.title: Agents
spec.description: Live, dormant and online identities over time. Online is a subset of live, so the gap between them is agents registered with no session open.

defaults.noValue: No data from grelot in this range

spec.title: Threads and reservations
spec.description: Threads with unexpired messages by kind, and reservations held and queued. Threads expire with their last message, so a count that only grows means posts keep arriving faster than they expire.

defaults.noValue: No data from grelot in this range

spec.title: Unread mail
spec.description: Messages delivered and not yet read, over time. Short peaks are normal while agents work, and a level that never returns to 0 means some reader is not being woken.

defaults.noValue: No data from grelot in this range

spec.title: Oldest unread age
spec.description: How long the oldest unread message has waited, over time. A line that climbs without falling back is one reader that stopped reading, often a session closed without grelot bye.

defaults.noValue: No data from grelot in this range

spec.title: Requests per second by route
spec.description: Requests grelot answered, by route pattern, with unmatched for paths no route serves. A steady rate of unmatched requests is a client or scanner calling paths grelot does not have.

defaults.noValue: No data from grelot in this range

spec.title: Server errors per minute by route
spec.description: Requests answered with a 5xx status, by route and code. A 507 is a full store and a 503 a request that timed out, and each 500 has a request failed error line naming the cause.

defaults.noValue: No data from grelot in this range

spec.title: Request latency p95 by route
spec.description: The 95th percentile (p95) time grelot took to answer, by route. Standing waits and inbox reads are left out because they are held open on purpose until mail arrives.

defaults.noValue: No data from grelot in this range

spec.title: Store size
spec.description: The store file's size, the bytes in use and free inside it, and the `STORE_MAX_BYTES` ceiling. Posts are refused once the bytes in use pass 90% of the ceiling, and free pages are reused before the file grows.

defaults.noValue: No data from grelot in this range

spec.title: Time since the last sweep
spec.description: Seconds since the store sweep last committed, with failed passes per hour. The sweep runs every 15 seconds, and past a minute the health check reports grelot unhealthy.

defaults.noValue: No data from grelot in this range

spec.title: Memory
spec.description: The Go heap in use and the process's resident memory. Resident memory close to the container's memory limit means the limit or `GOMEMLIMIT` is too low for the load.

defaults.noValue: No data from grelot in this range

spec.title: Goroutines
spec.description: Goroutines running in grelot. Each standing wait holds one, so the count follows the online agents, and growth with a flat agent count is a leak worth reporting.

defaults.noValue: No data from grelot in this range

spec.title: grelot

spec.name: logs
spec.label: Logs data source
spec.description: The Loki data source holding grelot's container logs, read only by the Latest messages panel.

spec.name: stream
spec.label: grelot log stream
spec.description: The Loki stream selector of grelot's container logs, which depends on how your log collector labels them, such as {container="grelot"}. It is empty until you set it, and only Latest messages reads it.

spec.name: attention
spec.label: Attention tiles shown
spec.description: How many Needs attention tiles have data. The row shows only while one does.

spec.query: query_result(count(label_replace(count(ALERTS{alertname="GrelotDown", alertstate="firing"}), "tile", "100", "", "") or label_replace(count(ALERTS{alertname="GrelotSweepStalled", alertstate="firing"}), "tile", "101", "", "") or label_replace(count(ALERTS{alertname="GrelotStoreStartedEmpty", alertstate="firing"}), "tile", "102", "", "") or label_replace(count(ALERTS{alertname="GrelotStoreNearlyFull", alertstate="firing"}), "tile", "103", "", "") or label_replace(count(ALERTS{alertname="GrelotStoreFull", alertstate="firing"}), "tile", "104", "", "") or label_replace(count(ALERTS{alertname="GrelotServerErrors", alertstate="firing"}), "tile", "105", "", "") or label_replace(count(ALERTS{alertname="GrelotPushFailing", alertstate="firing"}), "tile", "106", "", "") or label_replace(count(ALERTS{alertname="GrelotPushDoorOff", alertstate="firing"}), "tile", "107", "", "") or label_replace(count(ALERTS{alertname="GrelotProviderInvalid", alertstate="firing"}), "tile", "108", "", "")) or vector(0))

spec.definition: query_result(count(label_replace(count(ALERTS{alertname="GrelotDown", alertstate="firing"}), "tile", "100", "", "") or label_replace(count(ALERTS{alertname="GrelotSweepStalled", alertstate="firing"}), "tile", "101", "", "") or label_replace(count(ALERTS{alertname="GrelotStoreStartedEmpty", alertstate="firing"}), "tile", "102", "", "") or label_replace(count(ALERTS{alertname="GrelotStoreNearlyFull", alertstate="firing"}), "tile", "103", "", "") or label_replace(count(ALERTS{alertname="GrelotStoreFull", alertstate="firing"}), "tile", "104", "", "") or label_replace(count(ALERTS{alertname="GrelotServerErrors", alertstate="firing"}), "tile", "105", "", "") or label_replace(count(ALERTS{alertname="GrelotPushFailing", alertstate="firing"}), "tile", "106", "", "") or label_replace(count(ALERTS{alertname="GrelotPushDoorOff", alertstate="firing"}), "tile", "107", "", "") or label_replace(count(ALERTS{alertname="GrelotProviderInvalid", alertstate="firing"}), "tile", "108", "", "")) or vector(0))
